mira: Quick async standup — landed kernel slot-allocator patch (PR #4321) yesterday. Microbatch now respects max_latency; saw ~6% p99 improvement on short sequences. Blocker: kv-warmup still has intermittent misses on canary, looks like late evictions when slot-steal happens. Investigating with @ashok. Today: add eviction guard + unit tests, follow up on canary metrics.

ashok: Repro steps: I can repro locally with the perf harness. Suspect interaction between prefetch window and slot refill. Send me the trace id and I'll run a deeper trace. I also have a WIP eviction-policy tweak.

mira: trace id: trace-20260318-01. Flame shows evict at ~0.8s mark. Snippet: ```evict: slot=23 age=0.98s reason=slot-steal
kv_hot:true
prefetch_window:64```

lucy: Quick CR ping — @mira I left a comment on PR #4321 about using atomic ops for slot_refcount, tiny race nit. Also canary perf: baseline p99 220ms -> 206ms after patch, CPU +3%.

jorge: Ops FYI — deploy-bot reported canary 2/3 hosts hit OOM last night (might be unrelated). Can you run the bench command and paste results so we can correlate? `./tools/perf/run_bench --model=gpt-small --seq=512 --iters=200`

mira: Running now, will paste results in a sec.

dev-bot: canary-deploy 4321 started by mira at 2026-03-18T09:12:00Z

ashok: Quick workaround idea: bump kv.hot_ttl from 30s -> 120s on canary to reduce churn. This is masking root cause but useful for short-term stability.

mira: Bench results: ```throughput: 1200 tok/s
p50: 38ms
p95: 110ms
p99: 210ms
mem: 9.2GB
``` p99 improved slightly vs baseline. I'll push eviction-guard and update canary config (ttl bump as temporary).

lucy: LGTM on the follow-up plan. I can schedule a longer dedicated canary tomorrow morning to run overnight if that helps. :thumbsup:

ashok: I'll add a small harness test to stress the slot-steal path and assert no evictions under sustained prefetch. ETA EOD.

mira: Sounds good — blockers tracked, moving to close for today. Thanks team!
